mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises above 2.5% for 6 months but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls below 100 for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above 4.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 1,500 signals accelerating residential construction, which boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises above 1,500 for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the retail sales index (RSAFS) above 350,000 signals accelerating consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rises above 350,000 for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the personal income index (PAYEMS) above 130,000 signals accelerating household income growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rises above 130,000 for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL rises above 220 for 3 months but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.
